newsitem.title: ROMANIA: JANUARY-MARCH CONSTRUCTION 27.1 PCT DOWN IN ROMANI.
newsitem.headline: JANUARY-MARCH CONSTRUCTION 27.1 PCT DOWN IN ROMANI.

text.p: Construction in Romania fell by 27.1 percent to 2.38 trillion lei in the first quarter of 1997 from the year ago period, a National Statistics Board (CNS) report showed on Thursday.
Local economists say shortage of funds triggered by a soaring inflation earlier this year and tough monetary policies had triggered a sharp decline in construction activities.
Private companies accounted for 75.3 percent of the work, up from 66.5 percent in the same period last year.
Around 34 percent of the 1,579 flats finished over January-March were financed by the state, the report said.
Official forecasts say construction would inch up by 0.8 percent this year after a seven percent rise in 1996, when it accounted for about seven percent of gross domestic product.
